narrative.overview: A black stage with one soft spotlight: giant 900-weight stacked type in the hero, white fading to grey, then quieter grey detail, mono labels and hairlines, with a few saturated props (blue bolt, amber bracket, red corner marks, green live dot). Each section is its own set piece with its own motion. Layout and feel are adapted from a reference portfolio the owner chose, rebuilt from scratch with no copied code, copy or images; the content stays specific and factual.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: pure black ground, near-black surfaces, one off-white ink.
Inter at extreme weights does nearly everything; Playfair italic is the single expressive counterpoint, one phrase per headline.
Grey carries the supporting tier; saturated colour appears only in small props.
Every section has its own motion idea, built with CSS and small scroll handlers, with a reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Colour is a prop, never a fill for whole sections. Saturated colour may cover an icon, dot, cube face or 1px line; large surfaces stay black, near-black or paper white.

rules.name: The Sheen Rule
rules.body: Display words that need depth use the .sheen white-to-grey text gradient, always beside a solid-white word so the fade reads as light, not as disabled.

rules.name: The One-Italic Rule
rules.body: A headline gets at most one Playfair italic phrase, the softer human half of the sentence. Never a whole heading in the serif.

rules.name: The Big-Then-Quiet Rule
rules.body: Each section has one shouting element; everything else steps down to body or label size.

rules.name: Sparing Shadows
rules.body: Shadows only where something physically sits over something else: the stats sheet, the back-to-top button and the paper work cards. Hover feedback is colour, border or a small translate.

rules.name: Dim Contrast
rules.body: Dim was raised from #71717a to #85858e so it passes 4.5:1 on black, Surface and Surface Raised (4.85:1 at worst). Re-check all three surfaces before darkening it or adding a grey.

dos: Do keep large surfaces black or near-black and spend colour on small props.
Do keep every claim factual and traceable to src/data/profile.ts.
Do give every new scroll or keyframe effect a reduced-motion path.
Do check new layouts at 390px for sideways scroll.
donts: Don't darken Dim below #85858e without re-checking AA contrast on every surface.
Don't copy text, images or code from the reference site.
Don't invent screenshots, testimonials or verification badges.
Don't reuse --font-* names for next/font variables; Tailwind v4's @theme owns them.
